description: This file defines the OfbizCacheStorage class, a custom cache implementation for caching FreeMarker templates within the Apache OFBiz framework. It wraps around UtilCache to manage cache operations such as get, put, remove, and clear.

classes.name: OfbizCacheStorage
classes.description: A class implementing the freemarker.cache.CacheStorage interface, providing caching functionality for FreeMarker templates using OFBiz's UtilCache.

methods.name: OfbizCacheStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the local cache with a specified ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object by key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores an object in the cache with the specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cached object associated with the specified key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.
